name: RackMac mini (2024+) 2U enclosure for 3 Mac mini
notes: 2U steel enclosure, 483 x 131 mm deep (5.2 in mounting depth), 2.7 kg. Holds one to three Mac mini (2024 and later) side by side. Each bay has a front power button that presses the Mac's underside button; front and rear openings reach all the Macs' ports; space under each Mac for a 4 x 4 x 0.5 in USB SSD. Add each Mac mini as its own device.

name: RackMac mini (2018-2023) 1U enclosure for 2 Mac mini
notes: 1U steel enclosure, 483 x 216 mm (8.25 in mounting depth), 3 kg. Holds two Mac mini (2011 to 2023, Intel, M1 and M2) side by side. Front: a power button and a USB 3 port for each Mac; open back with cable tie points. Add each Mac mini as its own device.

name: RackMac Studio 3U enclosure for 1 or 2 Mac Studio
notes: 3U steel enclosure, 9.5 in (241 mm) mounting depth. Holds one or two Mac Studio. Removable front panel with a power button for each Mac, pass-through USB-A ports, and access to the Macs' front ports and SD slots; open back. Space under each Mac for up to three Thunderbolt or USB SSDs. Add each Mac Studio as its own device.
